title: Security Deposit Account Funding Rules: Deposits, Installments, Guarantee Premiums and Pet Deposits
content:
**Account status.** Deposit funds are received into a Security Deposit Account only while the account is pending funding or held. The status is read from the account's own record.

**Due date and instruments.** The required deposit is due within the program's funding period, in calendar days after lease approval, and is accepted only in the program's accepted instruments. On the Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan the guarantee premium is due on the same terms.

**Guarantee premium.** The guarantee premium is the program's premium fraction times the coverage, rounded half up to the cent. The coverage is the program's coverage multiple times the monthly rent. The premium is paid again for each renewal term and is never refunded.

**Installments.** When a program allows installments, the cash deposit may be split into equal installments, up to the program's maximum count. The last installment absorbs any rounding. The first installment is due as above, and each later one is due the program's installment interval in calendar days after the previous one.

- The account reaches held when the first installment is received and the resident has signed the installment arrangement.
- An installment not received by its due date stays owed on the deposit account. It is never posted to the lease ledger, and it is simply not held at final accounting.

**Without installments.** The account reaches held only when the full required deposit, or the premium, is received. An account whose lease application is withdrawn or denied before any deposit is received closes from pending funding.

**Pet deposits.** An additional pet deposit required by the Pet Addendum is received into the same account while it is held.

**Interest.** Deposits bear no interest.

### Status test

| Account status | Deposit, installment, pet deposit or premium may be received |
|---|---|
| pending funding | yes |
| held | yes |
| move-out review, statement issued, in collections, closed | no |

### Worked illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- **Installments.** A hypothetical 1000.00 USD deposit split into 3 installments gives 333.33, 333.33 and 333.34 USD. The last installment absorbs the rounding.
- **Premium.** For a hypothetical monthly rent of 1700.00 USD with a coverage multiple of 1.50 and a premium fraction of 0.175, the coverage is 2550.00 USD. The premium is 0.175 times 2550.00, which is 446.25 USD.
- **Missed installment.** If the second of three installments is never received, the account still reached held on the first installment. The unpaid installment stays owed on the deposit account and is not held when the final account is drawn up.
